integrity.finite_verification: Standalone exhaustive script over selected fields, including GF(4); unrestricted claims supplied by mathematical proof.
integrity.scientific_provenance: Mathematical argument and reproducible code with explicit citations; no external certification asserted.

scientific_limitations: The structural normal form applies only when no poset chain contains three distinct elements.
Finite-field enumerator counts diagonal-one support, not ordinary linear rank.
Asymptotics fix the underlying finite bipartite graph as the field grows.
Comparison against some specialized incidence-algebra products literature remains incomplete; this is not a priority certification.
